values.note: $26 includes two vehicles; $9 each additional vehicle (interagency passes do not apply to it).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/beaver-creek-campground ('Single Site: $26 per night', '$9.00 each additional vehicle', 'Interagency Passes not applicable toward additional vehicle fees'; last updated May 1, 2026) + recreation.gov /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 09-26: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog for 233181 (all 61 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC, water hookup 'No'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Average trailer/RV spur 60' x 21'. Rec.gov catalogues 61 sites and lists a length for 22 of them (39-56 ft).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/beaver-creek-campground ('Camp sites: 67', 'Trailer/RV sites Average Parking Spur:60' x 21'') + rec.gov catalog (max vehicle length up to 56 ft), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Food storage lockers and trash pickup; firewood $10 a bundle.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/beaver-creek-campground ('Vault toilets, drinking water, food storage lockers and trash collection are provided.', 'No RV Dump Station', 'NO Shower facilities available at this campground.', 'Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Run by a concessionaire: recreation.gov's contact email and notices name ExplorUS ('USFS campgrounds managed by ExplorUS in the Custer-Gallatin National Forest'), facility line (661) 702-1420. All 61 catalogued sites are reservable; reserved sites are held until check-out time the day after the scheduled arrival.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/beaver-creek-campground ('Make Reservations Here') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233181 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 16; notices; 'For facility specific information, please call (661) 702-1420') + catalog (61 reservable), read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin NF, Hebgen Lake RD, on a hillside above the Madison River and Earthquake (Quake) Lake, ~24 mi from West Yellowstone (8 mi N on US 191, 16 mi W on US 287). Trails from the campground down to Earthquake Lake; Quake Lake visitor center nearby. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov (concessionaire ExplorUS; reservable): confirmed $26, no electric/water hookups, vault toilets, drinking water, no dump, rec.gov booking. Added 67 sites (FS; rec.gov catalogues 61), 56-ft max (catalog), no showers, season 5/15 - 9/27, 16-night limit. No alert for the campground or US 287. Note trimmed of restated values.
